names.en: FUJIAN KENT MECHANICAL AND ELECTRICAL CO., LTD (KENTPOWER)

strengths.text: Có dòng máy phát quân sự, máy phát dã chiến

quote: Military generator set is an important power supply equipment for weapon equipment under field conditions.

FUJIAN KENT MECHANICAL AND ELECTRICAL CO., LTD (KENTPOWER for short), founded in 2005 with a registered capital of USD$ 15 million, design and manufacture diesel generator sets, natural gas generator sets, solar power system
brand enterprises such as CUMMINS, PERKINS, MAN, VOLVO, MITSUBISHI, DEUTZ, DOOSAN, STAMFORD, LEROY SOMER, MARATHON, It has developed all types of diesel generator sets from 5Kva to 3000Kva
